historicDistrictFilter.rule: Removed secondary_old_house targets located inside Denver Historic Landmark District polygons. Vacant lots were retained.

vacantLandOnlyLayer.rule: Vacant land only. Kept priority_vacant_lot records; removed secondary old-house targets from active map layer. LLCs and missing-owner records remain allowed; obvious public/utility/rail/HOA/institutional owners excluded by prior builder.
